summary: Implementation plan for Cingcau: Apple Catch! featuring squishy SVG cube mascot Cingcau as the apple catcher, 2D HTML5 canvas + SVG game engine, synthesized Web Audio sound FX, multiple falling apple types (Red, Golden, Rotten), particles, 6 full screen flows (Start, How to Play, Main Game, Pause, Game Over, Level Complete), responsive touch/mouse/keyboard controls, and local high score persistence.
